rows.en: ▶ Monitor MHPSS-related outputs and outcomes: Where programmes in other areas of work contribute to improving mental health and psychosocial well-being, it can be useful to capture these outputs and outcomes (e.g. number of people with mental health conditions engaged in livelihoods programming; improvements in well-being following a participatory shelter programme).
rows.ne: ▶ MHPSS-सम्बन्धी प्रतिफल र परिणामहरूको अनुगमन गर्नुहोस्: अन्य कार्यक्षेत्रका कार्यक्रमहरूले मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा सुधार ल्याउन योगदान गर्ने अवस्थामा यी प्रतिफल र परिणामहरू अभिलेख गर्नु उपयोगी हुन सक्छ (जस्तै, जीविकोपार्जनसम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा संलग्न मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका व्यक्तिहरूको सङ्ख्या; सहभागितामूलक आश्रय कार्यक्रमपछि कल्याणमा भएको सुधार)।
rows.bt: ▶ Monitor MHPSS-related outputs and outcomes: Where programmes in other areas of work contribute to improving mental health and psychosocial well-being, it may be useful to record these outputs and outcomes (e.g., the number of people with mental health-related conditions involved in formulating and implementing livelihood-related programmes; improvement in well-being after a participatory shelter programme).
rows.note: Unvalidated draft preserving the conditional usefulness of recording results and the population without adding a functioning-impairment criterion.

rows.en: ▶ Ensure cross-referral mechanisms: This includes mapping of MHPSS services and facilitating the identification and referral of persons with possible mental health conditions by workers from different sectors. This also requires MHPSS workers to identify and refer persons to help meet their different needs (e.g. housing, livelihoods, social services).
rows.ne: ▶ परस्पर सेवा प्रेषण संयन्त्रहरू सुनिश्चित गर्नुहोस्: यसमा MHPSS सेवाहरूको नक्साङ्कन गर्ने र मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था हुन सक्ने व्यक्तिहरूको पहिचान तथा उनीहरूलाई सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्यमा विभिन्न क्षेत्रका कर्मचारीलाई सहजीकरण गर्ने काम समावेश हुन्छ। यसका लागि MHPSS कर्मचारीले पनि व्यक्तिहरूको पहिचान गरी उनीहरूका विभिन्न आवश्यकता (जस्तै, आवास, जीविकोपार्जन, सामाजिक सेवाहरू) पूरा गर्न सघाउन उनीहरूलाई सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउनुपर्छ।
rows.bt: ▶ Ensure mutual service referral mechanisms: This includes mapping MHPSS services and facilitating staff from various sectors in identifying people who may have mental health-related conditions and referring them to the relevant services. For this, MHPSS staff must also identify people and refer them to the relevant services to help meet their various needs (e.g., housing, livelihoods, social services).
rows.note: Unvalidated draft preserving reciprocal referral, possible rather than established conditions, and the separate referral obligation of MHPSS workers.

rows.en: The following key considerations provide examples of how MHPSS can be integrated into programming across different sectors and areas of work.
rows.ne: निम्न मुख्य विचारणीय पक्षहरूले विभिन्न क्षेत्र र कार्यक्षेत्रका कार्यक्रमको तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS कसरी एकीकृत गर्न सकिन्छ भन्ने उदाहरणहरू प्रस्तुत गर्छन्।
rows.bt: The following key considerations present examples of how MHPSS can be integrated into the design and implementation of programmes in different sectors and areas of work.

rows.en: Key Consideration 1: Integrating MHPSS into health programming
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 1: स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी कार्यक्रमको तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्ने
rows.bt: Key consideration 1: Integrating MHPSS into the design and implementation of health-related programmes

rows.en: Mental health is an integral part of health. Mental health and physical health are strongly interconnected, with one influencing the other.
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य समग्र स्वास्थ्यको अभिन्न अङ्ग हो। मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र शारीरिक स्वास्थ्य एकअर्कासँग गहिरो रूपमा अन्तरसम्बन्धित छन् र एउटाले अर्कोलाई प्रभाव पार्छ।
rows.bt: Mental health is an integral part of overall health. Mental health and physical health are deeply interconnected, and each affects the other.
rows.note: Mental health wording reuses the supplied unreviewed T157 candidate; the remaining statement is a general explanation of the relationship between mental and physical health.

rows.en: Health actors can integrate MHPSS into programming by:
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूले निम्न तरिकाले कार्यक्रमको तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: Relevant actors in the health sector can integrate MHPSS into programme design and implementation in the following ways.

rows.en: ▶ Including MHPSS in health assessments (see MSP activity 1.2).
rows.ne: ▶ स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी लेखाजोखामा MHPSS समावेश गर्ने (MSP गतिविधि 1.2 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Include MHPSS in health-related assessments (see MSP activity 1.2).

rows.en: ▶ Advocating for the provision of health services in ways that are inclusive, person-centered, promote dignity, enhance social support and respect human rights.
rows.ne: ▶ स्वास्थ्य सेवाहरू समावेशी र व्यक्तिकेन्द्रित हुने, मर्यादा प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने, सामाजिक सहयोग बढाउने र मानव अधिकारको सम्मान गर्ने तरिकाले उपलब्ध गराउन पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Advocate for health services to be provided in ways that are inclusive and person-centred, promote dignity, increase social support and respect human rights.
rows.note: Proposes a recurring nonclinical service-design term for 'person-centred'; the frozen glossary is unchanged.

rows.en: ▶ Advocating for addressing social determinants of mental health, including risks and protective factors.
rows.ne: ▶ जोखिमका कारक तथा संरक्षणकारी कारकहरूसहित मानसिक स्वास्थ्यका सामाजिक निर्धारकहरूलाई सम्बोधन गर्न पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Advocate for addressing the social determinants of mental health, including risk factors and protective factors.
rows.note: Social determinants, risk factors and protective factors are drafted as general public-health concepts, not diagnostic wording; recurring terminology proposals are provided.

rows.en: ▶ Engaging in advocacy, promotion and prevention together with other sectors and actors to build awareness of mental health, and to end stigma and discrimination.
rows.ne: ▶ मानसिक स्वास्थ्यबारे सचेतना बढाउन तथा कलङ्क र भेदभाव अन्त्य गर्न अन्य क्षेत्र र सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूसँग मिलेर पैरवी, प्रवर्द्धन र रोकथाममा संलग्न हुने।
rows.bt: ▶ Engage in advocacy, promotion and prevention together with other sectors and relevant actors to increase awareness of mental health and end stigma and discrimination.

rows.en: ▶ Orienting health workers on basic psychosocial support (see MSP activity 3.2).
rows.ne: ▶ स्वास्थ्यकर्मीलाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोगबारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्नुहोस् (MSP गतिविधि 3.2 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Orient health workers on basic psychosocial support (see MSP activity 3.2).
rows.note: Unvalidated draft treating basic psychosocial support as a general support category rather than a named therapy.

rows.en: ▶ Integrating programs that promote mental health for caregivers, children and adolescents into health services (see MSP activities 3.5 and 3.7).
rows.ne: ▶ हेरचाहकर्ता, बालबालिका तथा किशोरकिशोरीको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने कार्यक्रमहरूलाई स्वास्थ्य सेवामा एकीकृत गर्ने (MSP गतिविधिहरू 3.5 र 3.7 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Integrate programmes that promote the mental health of caregivers, children and adolescents into health services (see MSP activities 3.5 and 3.7).
rows.note: The mental health term reuses the supplied unreviewed T157 candidate; this row concerns programme integration rather than a new clinical procedure.

rows.en: ▶ Integrating mental health care into general health care and other health services (see MSP activity 3.10).
rows.ne: ▶ मानसिक स्वास्थ्य हेरचाहलाई सामान्य स्वास्थ्य हेरचाह र अन्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाहरूमा एकीकृत गर्नुहोस् (MSP गतिविधि 3.10 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Integrate mental health care into general health care and other health services (see MSP activity 3.10).
rows.note: Unvalidated draft preserving integration into both general health care and other health services without restricting care to a named treatment.

rows.en: See relevant resources on the MHPSS MSP web platform.
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP वेब प्लेटफर्ममा सम्बन्धित स्रोत सामग्रीहरू हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: See the related resource materials on the MHPSS MSP web platform.

rows.en: Key consideration 2: Integrating MHPSS into education programming
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 2: शिक्षासम्बन्धी कार्यक्रमको तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्ने
rows.bt: Key consideration 2: Integrating MHPSS into the design and implementation of education-related programmes

rows.en: Education can offer a stable routine and structure, support a sense of normality, promote children’s social and emotional development, play and foster hope. Learning spaces provide opportunities for peer and adult support and can unite the wider community. MHPSS is inherent to this work, helping children, caregivers and education personnel to cope, build resilience and promoting a supportive environment.
rows.ne: शिक्षाले स्थिर दिनचर्या र व्यवस्थित ढाँचा उपलब्ध गराउन, सामान्य अवस्था रहेको अनुभूतिलाई टेवा दिन, बालबालिकाको सामाजिक तथा भावनात्मक विकास र खेललाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्न तथा आशा जगाउन सक्छ। सिकाइ स्थलहरूले समवयस्क र वयस्कबाट सहयोग प्राप्त गर्ने अवसर प्रदान गर्छन् र बृहत् समुदायलाई एकताबद्ध बनाउन सक्छन्। MHPSS यस कार्यको अभिन्न अङ्ग हो; यसले बालबालिका, हेरचाहकर्ता तथा शिक्षा क्षेत्रका कर्मचारीलाई कठिनाइको सामना गर्न र कठिनाइमा टिक्न, अनुकूल हुन तथा पुनः सम्हालिन सक्ने क्षमता विकास गर्न मद्दत गर्छ तथा सहयोगी वातावरण प्रवर्द्धन गर्छ।
rows.bt: Education can provide a stable routine and an organized structure, support a sense of normality, promote children's social and emotional development and play, and inspire hope. Learning sites provide opportunities to receive support from peers and adults and can unite the wider community. MHPSS is an integral part of this work; it helps children, caregivers and education sector staff to cope with difficulties and to develop the capacity to withstand difficulties, adapt and recover, and promotes a supportive environment.
rows.note: Coping and resilience are expressed descriptively in their ordinary educational sense, without introducing a named clinical intervention or claiming validated clinical terminology. The original renders a stable routine as merely regular and narrows resilience to recovery after difficulties. The revision restores stability and includes withstanding and adapting to difficulties, rather than recovery alone.

rows.en: Education actors can integrate MHPSS into programming by:
rows.ne: शिक्षा क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूले निम्न तरिकाले कार्यक्रमको तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: Actors working in the education sector can integrate MHPSS into programme design and implementation in the following ways.

rows.en: ▶ Including the mental health and psychosocial well-being of target communities (including children, caregivers and education personnel) in education needs assessments (see MSP activities 1.2 and 2.1).
rows.ne: ▶ शिक्षासम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखामा लक्षित समुदायहरूका सदस्यहरूको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण समावेश गर्ने, जसमा बालबालिका, हेरचाहकर्ता तथा शिक्षा क्षेत्रका कर्मचारी पनि पर्छन् (MSP गतिविधिहरू 1.2 र 2.1 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Include the mental health and psychosocial well-being of members of the target communities, including children, caregivers and education-sector staff, in assessments of education-related needs (see MSP activities 1.2 and 2.1).
rows.note: Mental health and psychosocial well-being reuse the supplied unreviewed T157 and T005 candidates.

rows.en: ▶ Providing and advocating across sectors for the provision of services in ways that promote the dignity of crisis-affected people and are inclusive, participatory, person-centred, and rights-based.
rows.ne: ▶ सङ्कटबाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूको मर्यादा प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने तथा समावेशी, सहभागितामूलक, व्यक्तिकेन्द्रित र अधिकारमा आधारित तरिकाले सेवाहरू उपलब्ध गराउने र विभिन्न क्षेत्रहरूमा त्यस्ता सेवा उपलब्ध गराउन पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Promote the dignity of people affected by crisis, provide services in inclusive, participatory, person-centred and rights-based ways, and advocate for such services to be provided across different sectors.
rows.note: Uses the proposed nonclinical service-design equivalent for the recurring term 'person-centred'.

rows.en: ▶ Advocating to address social determinants of mental health and psychosocial well-being, including risk and protective factors.
rows.ne: ▶ जोखिमका कारक तथा संरक्षणकारी कारकहरूसहित मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका सामाजिक निर्धारकहरूलाई सम्बोधन गर्न पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Advocate for addressing the social determinants of mental health and psychosocial well-being, including risk factors and protective factors.
rows.note: Uses supplied unreviewed candidates for mental health and psychosocial well-being, with proposed general public-health wording for the recurring determinants and factor terms.

rows.en: ▶ Orienting all frontline education staff in basic psychosocial support for children and adults (see MSP activity 3.2).
rows.ne: ▶ बालबालिका र वयस्कहरूका लागि आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोगबारे अग्रपङ्क्तिमा कार्यरत सबै शिक्षा क्षेत्रका कर्मचारीलाई अभिमुखीकरण गर्नुहोस् (MSP गतिविधि 3.2 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Orient all education-sector staff working on the front line on basic psychosocial support for children and adults (see MSP activity 3.2).
rows.note: Unvalidated draft retaining all frontline education staff as recipients of orientation and both children and adults as recipients of support.

rows.en: ▶ Incorporating key MHPSS messages into education activities and informational materials (see MSP activity 3.3).
rows.ne: ▶ शिक्षासम्बन्धी गतिविधि तथा सूचनामूलक सामग्रीहरूमा मुख्य MHPSS सन्देशहरू समावेश गर्ने (MSP गतिविधि 3.3 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Include key MHPSS messages in education-related activities and informational materials (see MSP activity 3.3).

rows.en: ▶ Providing MHPSS services as a part of Education work (see MSP activities 3.4 to 3.8).
rows.ne: ▶ शिक्षासम्बन्धी कार्यको अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS सेवाहरू प्रदान गर्ने (MSP गतिविधिहरू 3.4 देखि 3.8 सम्म हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Provide MHPSS services as part of education-related work (see MSP activities 3.4 to 3.8).

rows.en: ▶ Working closely with actors in child protection, ECD, GBV, health and other areas of work to define roles and responsibilities, avoid duplication, improve the quality of care and ensure MHPSS activities are consistent and mutually-reinforcing.
rows.ne: ▶ भूमिका तथा जिम्मेवारीहरू निर्धारण गर्न, दोहोरोपनबाट बच्न, हेरचाहको गुणस्तर सुधार गर्न र MHPSS गतिविधिहरू एकरूप तथा एकअर्कालाई सुदृढ बनाउने किसिमका छन् भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्न बाल संरक्षण, ECD, GBV, स्वास्थ्य तथा अन्य कार्यक्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूसँग निकट सहकार्य गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Work closely with relevant actors in child protection, ECD, GBV, health and other areas of work to define roles and responsibilities, avoid duplication, improve the quality of care and ensure that MHPSS activities are consistent and mutually reinforcing.

rows.en: ▶ Establishing joint referral pathways and SOPs for the referral of children and adults, including facilitating access to the full range of MHPSS activities and services as needed.
rows.ne: ▶ बालबालिका र वयस्कलाई सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउनका लागि संयुक्त सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू तथा SOPs स्थापना गर्ने, जसमा आवश्यकताअनुसार सम्पूर्ण MHPSS गतिविधिहरू तथा सेवामा पहुँच सहज बनाउने कार्य पनि समावेश हुन्छ।
rows.bt: ▶ Establish joint service referral pathways and SOPs for referring children and adults to relevant services, including facilitating access to the full range of MHPSS activities and services as needed.
rows.note: General referral-system guidance drafted for review; this is not a consent declaration or a validated safeguarding protocol.

rows.en: ▶ Ensuring that education activities are accessible and meet the needs of people with mental health conditions.
rows.ne: ▶ शिक्षासम्बन्धी गतिविधिहरू पहुँचयोग्य छन् र मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका व्यक्तिहरूका आवश्यकता पूरा गर्छन् भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: ▶ Ensure that education-related activities are accessible and meet the needs of people with mental health-related conditions.
rows.note: Unvalidated draft preserving both accessibility and meeting needs without adding a functioning-impairment criterion to the population.

rows.en: ▶ Monitoring MHPSS-related outputs and outcomes (e.g. improvements in knowledge, attitudes and skills of education personnel participating in MHPSS orientations and trainings; improvements in subjective well-being among children following participation in structured group activities).
rows.ne: ▶ MHPSS-सम्बन्धी प्रतिफल र परिणामहरूको अनुगमन गर्नुहोस् (जस्तै, MHPSS अभिमुखीकरण र तालिमहरूमा सहभागी शिक्षा क्षेत्रका कर्मचारीको ज्ञान, दृष्टिकोण र सीपमा भएको सुधार; संरचित सामूहिक गतिविधिहरूमा सहभागितापछि बालबालिकामा व्यक्तिले अनुभूत गर्ने सुस्वास्थ्यमा भएको सुधार)।
rows.bt: ▶ Monitor MHPSS-related outputs and outcomes (e.g., improvement in the knowledge, attitudes and skills of education-sector staff who participate in MHPSS orientations and trainings; improvement in well-being experienced by the individual among children after participation in structured group activities).
rows.note: Unvalidated draft retaining subjective well-being as distinct from psychosocial well-being and preserving both monitoring examples.

rows.en: Key consideration 3: Integrating MHPSS into protection programming
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 3: संरक्षण कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्ने
rows.bt: Key consideration 3: Integrating MHPSS into protection programme design and implementation

rows.en: Protection programming in humanitarian crises contributes to the centrality of protection in humanitarian action. It supports understanding, respect for and access to rights of affected people in line with humanitarian principles and in accordance with relevant bodies of international human rights and humanitarian law. In practice, it involves a series of activities and services aimed at analyzing and monitoring protection risks, needs, vulnerabilities and capacities of individuals to address those needs; at preventing and mitigating exposure to protection risks and violations; at supporting affected people to claim their rights, access available remedies, and recover from the effects of violence, coercion, discrimination, and abuse. Protection programming includes integrating age, gender, and diversity4 considerations and applying a community-based approach, providing specialized protection services; integrating protection activities into the programming of other sector-specific responses; and supporting the mainstreaming of protection throughout the humanitarian response.
rows.ne: मानवीय सङ्कटका बेला गरिने संरक्षण कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनले मानवीय कार्यमा संरक्षणलाई केन्द्रमा राख्न योगदान पुर्‍याउँछ। यसले मानवीय सिद्धान्तअनुरूप तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार र मानवीय कानुनका सम्बन्धित प्रावधानअनुसार प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूका अधिकारबारे बुझाइ, ती अधिकारको सम्मान र तिनमा पहुँचलाई सहयोग गर्छ। व्यवहारमा, यसअन्तर्गत संरक्षणसम्बन्धी जोखिम, आवश्यकता, जोखिममा पर्ने अवस्था र ती आवश्यकता सम्बोधन गर्ने व्यक्तिहरूको क्षमताको विश्लेषण तथा अनुगमन गर्ने; संरक्षणसम्बन्धी जोखिम र अधिकार उल्लङ्घनमा पर्ने अवस्था रोक्ने तथा घटाउने; र प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूलाई आफ्ना अधिकार दाबी गर्न, उपलब्ध उपचारात्मक उपायमा पहुँच प्राप्त गर्न तथा हिंसा, जबरजस्ती, भेदभाव र दुर्व्यवहारका असरबाट सम्हालिन सहयोग गर्ने उद्देश्यका विभिन्न गतिविधि र सेवा पर्छन्। संरक्षण कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा उमेर, लैङ्गिकता र विविधता4 सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष समेट्ने तथा समुदायमा आधारित पद्धति अपनाउने, विशिष्टीकृत संरक्षण सेवा प्रदान गर्ने, अन्य क्षेत्रगत प्रतिकार्यका कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा संरक्षण गतिविधि एकीकृत गर्ने र समग्र मानवीय प्रतिकार्यमा संरक्षणलाई मूलप्रवाहीकरण गर्न सहयोग गर्ने कार्य समावेश हुन्छन्।
rows.bt: The design and implementation of protection programmes during humanitarian crises contributes to placing protection at the centre of humanitarian action. It supports understanding of, respect for and access to the rights of affected people in accordance with humanitarian principles and the relevant provisions of international human rights and humanitarian law. In practice, this includes various activities and services aimed at analysing and monitoring protection risks, needs, situations of being at risk and people's capacities to address those needs; preventing and reducing protection risks and exposure to rights violations; and helping affected people claim their rights, access available remedies and recover from the effects of violence, coercion, discrimination and abuse. The design and implementation of protection programmes includes incorporating considerations relating to age, gender and diversity4 and adopting community-based approaches, providing specialised protection services, integrating protection activities into the design and implementation of other sectoral response programmes, and supporting the mainstreaming of protection throughout the humanitarian response.
rows.note: General protection guidance drafted for review; not a verbatim safeguarding declaration. The footnote marker 4 remains attached to diversity. 'Return to a normal state' adds a normality endpoint absent from 'recover from the effects.' Revised that phrase without adding a clinical term. The source targets preventing and mitigating exposure to protection risks and violations, whereas the back-translation targets preventing and reducing protection risks themselves alongside exposure to rights violations.

rows.en: Incorporating MHPSS aspects effectively into protection programming and activities helps to mitigate immediate and long-term risks to the dignity, mental health, and psychosocial well-being of affected people.
rows.ne: संरक्षण कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयन र गतिविधिहरूमा MHPSS सम्बन्धी पक्ष प्रभावकारी रूपमा समावेश गर्दा प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूको मर्यादा, मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा पर्ने तत्कालीन तथा दीर्घकालीन जोखिम घटाउन मद्दत पुग्छ।
rows.bt: Effectively including MHPSS-related aspects in the planning and implementation of protection programmes and in activities helps reduce immediate and long-term risks to affected people's dignity, mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: The psychosocial well-being wording reuses the supplied unreviewed T005 candidate.

rows.en: Protection actors can integrate MHPSS into programming by:
rows.ne: संरक्षण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूले निम्न तरिकाबाट कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्न सक्छन्:
rows.bt: Actors working in the protection sector can integrate MHPSS into programme planning and implementation in the following ways:

rows.en: ▶ Ensuring that protection activities and services are accessible to and consider the specific needs of people with mental health conditions.
rows.ne: ▶ संरक्षणसम्बन्धी गतिविधि र सेवाहरू मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका व्यक्तिहरूका लागि पहुँचयोग्य छन् र तिनले यी व्यक्तिहरूका विशिष्ट आवश्यकतालाई ध्यानमा राख्छन् भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: ▶ Ensure that protection-related activities and services are accessible to people with mental health-related conditions and that they take into account the specific needs of these people.
rows.note: Unvalidated draft preserving accessibility and consideration of specific needs without narrowing the population by impairment.

rows.en: ▶ Including basic references to the mental health and psychosocial well-being needs of affected population in protection needs assessments and protection monitoring (see MSP activities 1.2 and 2.1).
rows.ne: ▶ संरक्षणसम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा र संरक्षण अनुगमनमा प्रभावित जनसङ्ख्याको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणसम्बन्धी आवश्यकताका आधारभूत उल्लेख समावेश गर्ने (MSP गतिविधिहरू 1.2 र 2.1 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Include basic references to the mental health and psychosocial well-being needs of the affected population in protection needs assessments and protection monitoring (see MSP activities 1.2 and 2.1).
rows.note: The assessment reference retains both activity codes; psychosocial well-being uses the supplied unreviewed candidate.

rows.en: ▶ Incorporating key MHPSS messages into information materials and in communications with communities during all phases of humanitarian action (see MSP activity 3.3).
rows.ne: ▶ मानवीय कार्यका सबै चरणमा सूचना सामग्री र समुदायसँग गरिने सञ्चारमा मुख्य MHPSS सन्देशहरू समावेश गर्ने (MSP गतिविधि 3.3 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Include key MHPSS messages in information materials and communication with communities at all stages of humanitarian action (see MSP activity 3.3).

rows.en: ▶ Including MHPSS service providers in protection service mapping to support information sharing and referrals.
rows.ne: ▶ सूचना आदानप्रदान र सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्यमा सहयोग गर्न संरक्षण सेवाहरूको नक्साङ्कनमा MHPSS सेवा प्रदायकहरूलाई समावेश गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Include MHPSS service providers in the mapping of protection services to support information exchange and referral to relevant services.
rows.note: Service mapping and referral guidance is drafted for safety review; it does not add authorization to disclose information or transfer individuals.

rows.en: ▶ Establishing joint referral pathways between protection and MHPSS actors to facilitate access to the full range of MHPSS activities and services by individuals in need.
rows.ne: ▶ आवश्यकतामा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूलाई उपलब्ध सबै प्रकारका MHPSS गतिविधिहरू र सेवामा पहुँच सहज बनाउन संरक्षण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू र MHPSS क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूबीच संयुक्त सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू स्थापना गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Establish joint service referral pathways between actors working in the protection sector and actors working in the MHPSS sector to facilitate access for people in need to all types of available MHPSS activities and services.
rows.note: Joint referral-pathway guidance is drafted for safety review; access is facilitated rather than presented as automatic transfer.

rows.en: ▶ Orienting all frontline protection staff in basic psychosocial support for girls, boys, women and men, and other individuals with diverse characteristics (see MSP activity 3.2).
rows.ne: ▶ संरक्षण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत सबै अग्रपंक्तिका कर्मचारीलाई बालिका, बालक, महिला र पुरुष तथा विविध विशेषता भएका अन्य व्यक्तिहरूका लागि आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोगबारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने (MSP गतिविधि 3.2 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Orient all frontline staff working in the protection sector on basic psychosocial support for girls, boys, women and men and other people with diverse characteristics (see MSP activity 3.2).
rows.note: Basic psychosocial support reuses wording from the supplied unreviewed activity 3.2 candidate. Frontline staff is a recurring operational term proposed separately.

rows.en: ▶ Training case managers on relevant MHPSS topics (see MSP activity 3.13 and the recommended MHPSS training topics for case managers).
rows.ne: ▶ केस व्यवस्थापकहरूलाई सान्दर्भिक MHPSS विषयमा तालिम दिने (MSP गतिविधि 3.13 र केस व्यवस्थापकहरूका लागि सिफारिस गरिएका MHPSS तालिमका विषयहरू हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Train case managers on relevant MHPSS topics (see MSP activity 3.13 and the recommended MHPSS training topics for case managers).

rows.en: ▶ Advocating with duty bearers for non-discrimination, access to social services and equal enjoyment of basic human rights by people with mental health conditions and psychosocial problems.
rows.ne: ▶ मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका र मनोसामाजिक समस्याहरू भएका व्यक्तिहरूका लागि भेदभाव नहुने व्यवस्था, सामाजिक सेवाहरूमा पहुँच र आधारभूत मानव अधिकारको समान उपभोग सुनिश्चित गर्न दायित्व भएका पक्षहरूसँग पैरवी गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: ▶ Advocate with parties who have obligations to ensure arrangements without discrimination, access to social services and equal enjoyment of basic human rights for people with mental health-related conditions and psychosocial problems.
rows.note: Unvalidated draft preserving advocacy with duty bearers and both population descriptors without adding a functioning-impairment criterion.

rows.en: ▶ Advocating to address social factors influencing mental health and psychosocial well-being amongst affected populations (e.g. mitigating risk factors, promoting protective factors.
rows.ne: ▶ प्रभावित जनसङ्ख्याको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा प्रभाव पार्ने सामाजिक कारक सम्बोधन गर्न पैरवी गर्ने (उदाहरणका लागि, जोखिम बढाउने कारक घटाउने र संरक्षणकारी कारक प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने)।
rows.bt: ▶ Advocate to address social factors that affect the mental health and psychosocial well-being of the affected population (for example, reducing factors that increase risk and promoting protective factors).
rows.note: The source opens but does not close the example parenthesis; the draft closes it without adding an example. Advocacy, risk factors and protective factors are recurring terms proposed for glossary review.

rows.en: ▶ Contributing to monitor overall MHPSS-related outcomes (e.g. improvements in subjective well-being, functioning, coping, and/or social connectedness following participation in protection activities).
rows.ne: ▶ समग्र MHPSS-सम्बन्धी परिणामहरूको अनुगमनमा योगदान गर्नुहोस् (जस्तै, संरक्षणसम्बन्धी गतिविधिहरूमा सहभागितापछि व्यक्तिले अनुभूत गर्ने सुस्वास्थ्य, कार्यशीलता, परिस्थितिको सामना गर्ने क्षमता र/वा सामाजिक आबद्धतामा भएको सुधार)।
rows.bt: ▶ Contribute to monitoring overall MHPSS-related outcomes (e.g., improvement in well-being experienced by the individual, functioning, ability to cope with circumstances and/or social connectedness after participation in protection-related activities).
rows.note: Unvalidated draft preserving contribution rather than sole responsibility for monitoring and retaining the source's and/or relationship between outcome examples.

rows.en: ▶ Reinforcing joint advocacy between protection and MHPSS across sectors to consider MHPSS as a cross-cutting issue in the humanitarian response, and for the provision of services in ways that promote dignity are inclusive, community-based, participatory, people-centred, and rights-based (see MSP activity 3.1).
rows.ne: ▶ मानवीय प्रतिकार्यमा MHPSS लाई सबै क्षेत्रमा समेटिने विषयका रूपमा विचार गर्न तथा मर्यादा प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने, समावेशी, समुदायमा आधारित, सहभागितामूलक, व्यक्तिकेन्द्रित र अधिकारमा आधारित तरिकाले सेवा प्रदान गर्न क्षेत्रहरूमा संरक्षण र MHPSS बीचको संयुक्त पैरवी सुदृढ गर्ने (MSP गतिविधि 3.1 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Strengthen joint advocacy between protection and MHPSS across sectors to consider MHPSS as a topic to be included in all sectors in the humanitarian response and to provide services in ways that promote dignity and are inclusive, community-based, participatory, person-centred and rights-based (see MSP activity 3.1).
rows.note: The source lacks a connector after 'promote dignity'; the draft treats the following descriptors as parallel requirements for service provision. Advocacy is proposed as a recurring glossary term. The draft makes protection and MHPSS the topics of advocacy rather than the two sides undertaking joint advocacy. Revised to retain 'between protection and MHPSS' and removed the added necessity in the rendering of 'cross-cutting.' The missing source connector after 'dignity' remains pending source review; the parallel-descriptor reading is not validated.

rows.en: See relevant resources on the MHPSS MSP web platform. See also key considerations 4, 5 and 6.
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP वेब प्लेटफर्ममा सान्दर्भिक स्रोत सामग्री हेर्नुहोस्। मुख्य विचारणीय पक्षहरू 4, 5 र 6 पनि हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: See relevant resource materials on the MHPSS MSP web platform. Also see key considerations 4, 5 and 6.

rows.en: 4 Diversity refers to differences in values, attitudes, cultural perspectives, beliefs, ethnic background, nationality, sexual orientation, gender identity, health, social status, impairments, and other specific personal characteristics (as defined in the 2019 IASC Guidelines on the Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities in Humanitarian Action).
rows.ne: 4 विविधता भन्नाले मूल्य, दृष्टिकोण, सांस्कृतिक परिप्रेक्ष्य, विश्वास, जातीय पृष्ठभूमि, राष्ट्रियता, यौन अभिमुखता, लैङ्गिक पहिचान, स्वास्थ्य, सामाजिक हैसियत, अङ्ग वा कार्यक्षमतामा भएका कमी र अन्य विशिष्ट व्यक्तिगत विशेषतामा रहेका भिन्नतालाई जनाउँछ (मानवीय कार्यमा अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्तिहरूको समावेशितासम्बन्धी 2019 IASC निर्देशिकाहरूमा परिभाषित गरिएअनुसार)।
rows.bt: 4 Diversity refers to differences in values, attitudes, cultural perspectives, beliefs, ethnic backgrounds, nationalities, sexual orientations, gender identities, health, social status, impairments of body parts or functioning and other specific personal characteristics (as defined in the 2019 IASC guidelines on the inclusion of persons with disabilities in humanitarian action).
rows.note: Reclassified as an ordinary diversity definition rather than an instruction. The cited guideline title is a descriptive draft rendering, not an asserted official Nepali title.

rows.en: Key consideration 4: Integrating MHPSS into child protection programming
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 4: बाल संरक्षण कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्ने
rows.bt: Key consideration 4: Integrating MHPSS into the planning and implementation of child protection programmes
rows.note: Reclassified as a heading. The singular heading form corresponds to the supplied plural key-considerations candidate and remains unreviewed.

rows.en: Child protection is the prevention of and response to abuse, neglect, exploitation, and violence against children. MHPSS is inherent to this work, helping children to cope, recover, and build resilience in the face of adversity.
rows.ne: बाल संरक्षण भनेको बालबालिकाविरुद्ध हुने दुर्व्यवहार, उपेक्षा, शोषण र हिंसाको रोकथाम तथा प्रतिकार्य हो। MHPSS यस कार्यको अभिन्न अङ्ग हो, जसले बालबालिकालाई प्रतिकूलताको सामना गर्न, त्यसका असरबाट सम्हालिन र प्रतिकूलता सहन तथा त्यसबाट पुनः सम्हालिन सक्ने क्षमता विकास गर्न मद्दत गर्छ।
rows.bt: Child protection is the prevention of and response to abuse, neglect, exploitation and violence against children. MHPSS is an integral part of this work, helping children face adversity, recover from its effects and develop the capacity to withstand adversity and recover from it again.
rows.note: General child-protection explanation drafted for safety review. Coping, recovery and resilience are expressed here as ordinary capacities, not diagnoses or validated outcome items. 'Return to a normal state' adds an endpoint absent from 'recover.' Replaced it with ordinary recovery wording while retaining coping and resilience as distinct capacities.

rows.en: Child protection actors can integrate MHPSS into programming by:
rows.ne: बाल संरक्षण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूले निम्न तरिकाबाट कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्न सक्छन्:
rows.bt: Actors working in the child protection sector can integrate MHPSS into programme planning and implementation in the following ways:

rows.en: ▶ Including the mental health and psychosocial well-being of boys and girls of different ages in child protection needs assessments (see MSP activities 1.2 and 2.1).
rows.ne: ▶ बाल संरक्षणसम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखामा विभिन्न उमेरका बालक र बालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याण समावेश गर्ने (MSP गतिविधिहरू 1.2 र 2.1 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Include the mental health and psychosocial well-being of boys and girls of different ages in child protection needs assessments (see MSP activities 1.2 and 2.1).
rows.note: Both boys and girls and their differing ages are retained; psychosocial well-being reuses the supplied unreviewed candidate.

rows.en: ▶ Providing and advocating across sectors for the provision of services in ways that are inclusive, participatory, child-centred, rights-based, and promote the dignity of children and adolescents.
rows.ne: ▶ समावेशी, सहभागितामूलक, बालकेन्द्रित र अधिकारमा आधारित तथा बालबालिका तथा किशोरकिशोरीको मर्यादा प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने तरिकाले सेवा प्रदान गर्ने र यसरी सेवा प्रदान गर्न सबै क्षेत्रमा पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Provide services in a way that is inclusive, participatory, child-centred and rights-based and promotes the dignity of children and adolescents, and advocate across all sectors for services to be provided in this way.
rows.note: Both direct service provision and cross-sector advocacy are retained. Advocacy is proposed as a recurring glossary term.

rows.en: ▶ Advocating to address social determinants of mental health and psychosocial wellbeing among children, adolescents, and caregivers, including risk and protective factors.

rows.en: ▶ Working closely with actors in education, ECD, GBV, health and other areas of work to ensure MHPSS activities for children, adolescents and caregivers are consistent and mutually-reinforcing.

rows.bt: ▶ Monitor MHPSS-related outputs and outcomes (e.g., improvement in the knowledge, attitudes and skills of caregivers who participate in MHPSS orientations and trainings; improvement in well-being experienced by the individual among children and adolescents after participation in structured group activities).

rows.en: Key consideration 5: Integrating MHPSS into GBV programming
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्षहरू 5: GBV कार्यक्रमहरूमा MHPSS एकीकरण
rows.bt: Key considerations 5: Integration of MHPSS into GBV programmes

rows.en: GBV programming focuses on prevention of and response to Gender-Based Violence. GBV disproportionately affects women and girls, though, men and boys can also experience sexual violence and abuse. MHPSS is an essential component of GBV programming. While survivors’ experiences vary, the impacts of GBV on mental health and psychosocial well-being can have extensive consequences for individuals, families, and communities. Addressing the mental health and psychosocial needs of survivors and those at risk of GBV, as well as preventing violence, is critical to promoting gender equality, resilience and recovery.
rows.ne: GBV सम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयन लैङ्गिक हिंसाको रोकथाम र त्यसप्रतिको प्रतिकार्यमा केन्द्रित हुन्छ। GBV ले महिला र बालिकाहरूलाई अनुपातहीन रूपमा बढी असर गर्छ, यद्यपि पुरुष र बालकहरूले पनि यौन हिंसा र दुर्व्यवहार भोग्न सक्छन्। MHPSS, GBV सम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनको अत्यावश्यक घटक हो। प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूका अनुभव फरकफरक भए पनि मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा GBV ले पार्ने असरका कारण व्यक्ति, परिवार र समुदायमा व्यापक परिणामहरू देखिन सक्छन्। लैङ्गिक समानता, उत्थानशीलता र पुनर्लाभलाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्न प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू तथा GBV को जोखिममा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूका मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक आवश्यकताहरू सम्बोधन गर्नुका साथै हिंसाको रोकथाम गर्नु अत्यन्त महत्त्वपूर्ण छ।
rows.bt: Planning and implementation of GBV-related programmes focus on the prevention of and response to gender-based violence. GBV disproportionately affects women and girls more, although men and boys can also experience sexual violence and abuse. MHPSS is an essential component of planning and implementation of GBV-related programmes. Although the experiences of affected people differ, the effects of GBV on mental health and psychosocial well-being can have wide-ranging consequences for individuals, families and communities. To promote gender equality, resilience and recovery, it is extremely important to address the mental health and psychosocial needs of affected people and people at risk of GBV, as well as to prevent violence.
rows.note: Frozen T317 denotes affected persons, potentially including indirectly affected people, whereas survivors here denotes people who directly experienced and survived GBV; the source population must not be broadened. bt-divergence: Frozen प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू means affected persons, potentially including indirectly affected people; the source specifies survivors in both the experiences and needs clauses. The frozen form is retained; otherwise aligned.

rows.en: GBV actors can integrate MHPSS into programming by:
rows.ne: GBV क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूले निम्न उपाय अपनाएर कार्यक्रमहरूमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्न सक्छन्:
rows.bt: Actors working in the GBV sector can integrate MHPSS into programmes by adopting the following measures:

rows.en: ▶ Including the mental health and psychosocial well-being of women, men, boys, girls and persons with diverse sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression and sex characteristics (SOGIESC) in needs assessments (see MSP activities 1.2 and 2.1).
rows.ne: ▶ आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखामा महिला, पुरुष, बालक, बालिका र विविध यौन अभिमुखीकरण, लैङ्गिक पहिचान, लैङ्गिक अभिव्यक्ति तथा लिङ्गसम्बन्धी विशेषता (SOGIESC) भएका व्यक्तिहरूको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण समावेश गर्ने (MSP गतिविधि 1.2 र 2.1 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Include the mental health and psychosocial well-being of women, men, boys, girls and people with diverse sexual orientations, gender identities, gender expressions and sex characteristics (SOGIESC) in needs assessments (see MSP activities 1.2 and 2.1).
rows.note: The well-being phrase reuses supplied unreviewed candidates T157 and T005. SOGIESC is retained with all four components; terminology review is pending.

rows.en: ▶ Providing and advocating across sectors for the provision of services in ways that promote safety and dignity of GBV survivors, particularly women and girls, and are safe, confidential, inclusive, community-based, participatory, survivor-centred, and rights-based.
rows.ne: ▶ GBV बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू, विशेष गरी महिला र बालिकाहरूको सुरक्षा र मर्यादालाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने तथा सुरक्षित, गोपनीय, समावेशी, समुदायमा आधारित, सहभागितामूलक, प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूमा केन्द्रित र अधिकारमा आधारित हुने गरी सेवाहरू उपलब्ध गराउने र विभिन्न क्षेत्रहरूमा यसरी सेवा उपलब्ध गराउन पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Promote the safety and dignity of people affected by GBV, especially women and girls, and provide services in a way that is safe, confidential, inclusive, community-based, participatory, centred on affected people and rights-based, and advocate for providing services in this way across different sectors.
rows.note: Frozen T139 and T317 denote affected persons rather than specifically survivors; their use also renders survivor-centred as affected-person-centred, broadening both the population label and the stated service principle. bt-divergence: Frozen GBV बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू broadens GBV survivors to people affected by GBV, and प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूमा केन्द्रित broadens survivor-centred to affected-person-centred. The frozen forms are retained; otherwise aligned.

rows.en: ▶ Advocating to address social determinants of mental health and psychosocial well-being (e.g. levels of social support, exclusion, deprivation, poverty) among GBV survivors, particularly women and girls, including addressing risks and promoting protective factors.
rows.ne: ▶ GBV बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू, विशेष गरी महिला र बालिकाहरूका मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका सामाजिक निर्धारकहरू (जस्तै सामाजिक सहयोगको स्तर, बहिष्करण, वञ्चना, गरिबी) सम्बोधन गर्न पैरवी गर्ने, जसमा जोखिमहरू सम्बोधन गर्ने र संरक्षणकारी कारकहरूलाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने कार्य पनि समावेश छन्।
rows.bt: ▶ Advocate for addressing the social determinants of the mental health and psychosocial well-being of people affected by GBV, especially women and girls (such as the level of social support, exclusion, deprivation, poverty), including addressing risks and promoting protective factors.
rows.note: Frozen T139 denotes people affected by GBV and can include indirectly affected people, whereas the source specifically addresses social determinants among GBV survivors. bt-divergence: Frozen GBV बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू can include indirectly affected people, whereas the source specifies social determinants among GBV survivors. The frozen form is retained; otherwise aligned.

rows.en: ▶ Orienting all frontline GBV staff in basic psychosocial support (see MSP activity 3.2).
rows.ne: ▶ अग्रपंक्तिमा कार्यरत सबै GBV कर्मचारीलाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोगबारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने (MSP गतिविधि 3.2 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Orient all frontline GBV staff on basic psychosocial support (see MSP activity 3.2).
rows.note: The phrase '[Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]' is reused from the supplied unreviewed activity 3.2 candidate; it is not a newly coined clinical translation.

rows.en: ▶ Training case managers on relevant MHPSS topics (see MSP activity 3.13 and the recommended MHPSS training topics for case managers).
rows.ne: ▶ केस व्यवस्थापकहरूलाई सम्बन्धित MHPSS विषयहरूमा तालिम दिने (MSP गतिविधि 3.13 र केस व्यवस्थापकहरूका लागि सिफारिस गरिएका MHPSS तालिमका विषयहरू हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Train case managers on relevant MHPSS topics (see MSP activity 3.13 and the recommended MHPSS training topics for case managers).

rows.en: ▶ Incorporating key MHPSS messages into GBV activities and informational materials (see MSP activity 3.3).
rows.ne: ▶ GBV गतिविधिहरू र जानकारीमूलक सामग्रीमा मुख्य MHPSS सन्देशहरू समावेश गर्ने (MSP गतिविधि 3.3 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Include key MHPSS messages in GBV activities and informational materials (see MSP activity 3.3).

rows.en: ▶ Providing MHPSS services for women, girls and survivors as a part of GBV work (see MSP activities 3.4, 3.7, 3.9, 3.11 to 3.13 and 4.2).
rows.ne: ▶ GBV सम्बन्धी कार्यको अंशका रूपमा महिला, बालिका र प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूका लागि MHPSS सेवाहरू उपलब्ध गराउने (MSP गतिविधिहरू 3.4, 3.7, 3.9, 3.11 देखि 3.13 र 4.2 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Provide MHPSS services for women, girls and affected people as part of GBV-related work (see MSP activities 3.4, 3.7, 3.9, 3.11 to 3.13 and 4.2).
rows.note: Frozen T317 denotes affected persons and may include indirectly affected people, while the source specifies survivors as one of the recipient groups. bt-divergence: Frozen प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू broadens the specified survivor recipient group to affected persons, potentially including indirectly affected people. The frozen form is retained; otherwise aligned.

rows.en: ▶ Working closely with actors in Protection (including child protection), education, health and other areas of work to ensure MHPSS activities for GBV survivors, particularly women and girls are consistent and mutually-reinforcing.
rows.ne: ▶ GBV बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू, विशेष गरी महिला र बालिकाहरूका लागि सञ्चालन गरिने MHPSS गतिविधिहरू एकरूप र एकअर्कालाई सुदृढ बनाउने खालका छन् भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्न संरक्षण (बाल संरक्षणसहित), शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य र अन्य कार्यक्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूसँग निकट सहकार्य गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Work closely with relevant parties in protection (including child protection), education, health and other areas of work to ensure that MHPSS activities carried out for people affected by GBV, especially women and girls, are consistent and mutually reinforcing.
rows.note: Frozen T139 denotes people affected by GBV, potentially including indirectly affected people, whereas the source restricts the relevant MHPSS activities to GBV survivors. bt-divergence: Frozen GBV बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू potentially includes indirectly affected people, whereas the source specifies MHPSS activities for GBV survivors. The frozen form is retained; otherwise aligned.

rows.en: ▶ Establishing joint referral pathways and SOPs for the referral of women, girls and survivors to needed services, including facilitating access to the full range of MHPSS activities and services as needed.
rows.ne: ▶ महिला, बालिका र प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूलाई आवश्यक सेवाहरूमा पठाउन संयुक्त सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू र मानक सञ्चालन प्रक्रियाहरू (SOPs) स्थापना गर्ने, जसमा आवश्यकताअनुसार MHPSS गतिविधिहरू र सेवाहरूको सम्पूर्ण दायरामा पहुँच सहज बनाउने कार्य पनि समावेश छ।
rows.bt: ▶ Establish joint service referral pathways and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to refer women, girls and affected people to necessary services, including facilitating access to the full range of MHPSS activities and services as needed.
rows.note: Frozen T317 denotes affected persons rather than specifically survivors, potentially broadening referral recipients; the Nepali rendering of SOPs has no supplied frozen candidate. bt-divergence: Frozen प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू broadens survivors to affected persons among the referral recipients. The frozen form is retained; otherwise aligned.

rows.en: ▶ Ensuring that GBV activities are accessible and meet the needs of people with mental health conditions.
rows.ne: ▶ GBV गतिविधिहरू पहुँचयोग्य छन् र मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका व्यक्तिहरूका आवश्यकताहरू पूरा गर्छन् भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Ensure that GBV activities are accessible and meet the needs of people with mental health conditions.
rows.note: The population wording retains mental health conditions without adding a functional-impairment requirement.

rows.en: ▶ Monitoring MHPSS-related outputs and outcomes (e.g. improvements in subjective well-being, functioning, coping, and/or social connectedness following participation in GBV activities).
rows.ne: ▶ MHPSS सँग सम्बन्धित प्रतिफल र परिणामहरूको अनुगमन गर्ने (जस्तै GBV गतिविधिहरूमा सहभागी भएपछि व्यक्तिले अनुभूत गर्ने सुस्वास्थ्य, कार्यशीलता, सामना गर्ने क्षमता र/वा सामाजिक आबद्धतामा आएका सुधारहरू)।
rows.bt: ▶ Monitor MHPSS-related outputs and outcomes (such as improvements in the well-being, functioning, ability to cope and/or social connectedness that a person experiences after participating in GBV activities).
rows.note: The draft distinguishes outputs from outcomes and retains the source's and/or relationship among the example improvements.

rows.en: Key consideration 6: Integrating MHPSS into mine action programming
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्षहरू 6: बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यका कार्यक्रमहरूमा MHPSS एकीकरण
rows.bt: Key considerations 6: Integration of MHPSS into mine action programmes

rows.en: Survivors of explosive ordnances (EO) may have a range of MHPSS needs associated with their injuries or experiences of diminished independence, restricted access to activities, problems with self-image, chronic pain, phantom pain and social challenges (e.g. unemployment, changes to social roles, stigma, discrimination). The UN Policy on Victim Assistance in Mine Action and the International Mine Action Standards (IMAS 13.10) include ‘psychological and psychosocial support’ as one of six key components of Victim Assistance. Activities to prevent injuries and reduce risks can also be opportunities to integrate MHPSS, for example, incorporating key messages on MHPSS as part of Mine/EO risk education.
rows.ne: विस्फोटक आयुध (EO) बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूमा आफ्ना चोटपटक वा स्वतन्त्रता घटेको, गतिविधिहरूमा पहुँच सीमित भएको, आफूप्रतिको छविसम्बन्धी समस्या, दीर्घकालीन दुखाइ, फ्यान्टम दुखाइ (phantom pain) र सामाजिक चुनौतीहरू (जस्तै बेरोजगारी, सामाजिक भूमिकामा परिवर्तन, लाञ्छना, भेदभाव) भोगेका अनुभवसँग सम्बन्धित विभिन्न MHPSS आवश्यकताहरू हुन सक्छन्। बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यमा पीडित सहायतासम्बन्धी UN को नीति र बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यका अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मापदण्डहरू (IMAS 13.10) ले ‘मनोवैज्ञानिक तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग’ लाई पीडित सहायताका छ प्रमुख घटकमध्ये एकका रूपमा समावेश गर्छन्। चोटपटकको रोकथाम गर्ने र जोखिम घटाउने गतिविधिहरू MHPSS समावेश गर्ने अवसर पनि हुन सक्छन्, उदाहरणका लागि बारुदी सुरुङ/EO सम्बन्धी जोखिम शिक्षाको अंशका रूपमा MHPSS सम्बन्धी मुख्य सन्देशहरू समावेश गर्ने।
rows.bt: People affected by explosive ordnance (EO) may have various MHPSS needs related to their experiences of injuries or reduced independence, limited access to activities, problems related to self-image, chronic pain, phantom pain (phantom pain) and social challenges (such as unemployment, changes in social roles, stigma, discrimination). The UN policy on victim assistance in mine action and the International Mine Action Standards (IMAS 13.10) include ‘psychological and psychosocial support’ as one of the six main components of victim assistance. Activities that prevent injuries and reduce risk can also be opportunities to include MHPSS, for example by including key MHPSS-related messages as part of mine/EO risk education.
rows.note: Frozen T317 denotes affected persons rather than specifically people who survived explosive ordnance incidents; phantom pain and other clinical experience terms lack supplied frozen candidates, and the quoted support category is not a named therapy. bt-divergence: Frozen प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू potentially includes people indirectly affected by explosive ordnance, whereas the source specifies survivors of explosive ordnances. The frozen form is retained; otherwise aligned.

rows.en: Mine action actors can integrate MHPSS into programming by:
rows.ne: बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यमा संलग्न सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूले निम्न उपाय अपनाएर कार्यक्रमहरूमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्न सक्छन्:
rows.bt: Relevant actors involved in mine action can integrate MHPSS into programmes by adopting the following measures:

rows.en: ▶ Orienting all frontline mine action workers on basic psychosocial support, including support with motivation and perseverance in physical therapies, and the identification and referral of children and adults who may need MHPSS services and supports (see MSP activity 3.2).
rows.ne: ▶ अग्रपङ्क्तिमा काम गर्ने बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यका सबै कार्यकर्ताहरूलाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोगबारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने, जसमा भौतिक उपचारहरूका क्रममा उत्प्रेरणा र निरन्तर प्रयासका लागि सहयोग गर्ने तथा MHPSS सेवा र सहयोग आवश्यक पर्न सक्ने बालबालिका र वयस्कहरूको पहिचान गरी सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्य पनि समावेश छन् (MSP गतिविधि 3.2 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Orient all frontline mine action workers on basic psychosocial support, including supporting motivation and continued effort during physical treatments and identifying children and adults who may need MHPSS services and support and referring them to the relevant services (see MSP activity 3.2).
rows.note: Physical therapies is rendered as a general treatment category rather than a named therapy; the supplied glossary has no matching frozen form for that phrase.

rows.en: ▶ Integrating relevant key MHPSS messages into victim assistance and risk reduction information materials and activities (see MSP activity 3.3).
rows.ne: ▶ पीडित सहायता तथा जोखिम न्यूनीकरणसम्बन्धी जानकारीमूलक सामग्री र गतिविधिहरूमा सान्दर्भिक मुख्य MHPSS सन्देशहरू एकीकृत गर्ने (MSP गतिविधि 3.3 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Integrate relevant key MHPSS messages into informational materials and activities related to victim assistance and risk reduction (see MSP activity 3.3).

rows.en: ▶ Including information on injury prevention from EOs in relevant MHPSS activities (e.g. see MSP activities 3.6, 3.7, 3.8, 3.9).
rows.ne: ▶ सान्दर्भिक MHPSS गतिविधिहरूमा EOs बाट हुने चोटपटकको रोकथामसम्बन्धी जानकारी समावेश गर्ने (उदाहरणका लागि MSP गतिविधि 3.6, 3.7, 3.8, 3.9 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Include information on the prevention of injuries caused by EOs in relevant MHPSS activities (for example, see MSP activities 3.6, 3.7, 3.8, 3.9).
rows.note: Injury prevention is drafted as ordinary preventive guidance, not as clinical treatment wording. The source acronym EOs is retained exactly.

rows.en: ▶ Facilitating the inclusion of survivors of EO and their caregivers and families in community, cultural, sports and recreational activities (e.g. strengthening survivor networks and facilitating support groups at rehabilitation centres, orthopaedic wards, and health clinics; see MSP activity 3.4).
rows.ne: ▶ EO बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू तथा उनीहरूका हेरचाहकर्ता र परिवारलाई सामुदायिक, सांस्कृतिक, खेलकुद र मनोरञ्जनात्मक गतिविधिहरूमा समावेश गर्न सहजीकरण गर्ने (जस्तै बाँच्न सफल व्यक्तिहरूका सञ्जाल सुदृढ बनाउने र पुनर्स्थापना केन्द्रहरू, हाडजोर्नी उपचार वार्डहरू तथा स्वास्थ्य क्लिनिकहरूमा सहयोग समूहहरू सञ्चालन गर्न सहजीकरण गर्ने; MSP गतिविधि 3.4 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Facilitate the inclusion of people affected by EO and their caregivers and families in community, cultural, sports and recreational activities (such as strengthening networks of people who have survived and facilitating the running of support groups in rehabilitation centres, orthopaedic treatment wards and health clinics; see MSP activity 3.4).
rows.note: Frozen T317 denotes affected persons rather than specifically EO survivors, while T314 retains the survived-person sense in survivor networks; orthopaedic wards has no supplied frozen candidate. bt-divergence: Frozen प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू broadens EO survivors to affected persons and consequently broadens whose caregivers and families are included. The frozen survivor-network form retains the survival meaning. The frozen forms are retained; otherwise aligned.

rows.en: ▶ Training rehabilitation workers and victim assistance case managers on relevant MHPSS topics (see MSP activity 3.13 and the recommended MHPSS training topics for case managers).
rows.ne: ▶ पुनर्स्थापना कार्यकर्ताहरू र पीडित सहायताका केस व्यवस्थापकहरूलाई सान्दर्भिक MHPSS विषयहरूमा तालिम दिने (MSP गतिविधि 3.13 र केस व्यवस्थापकहरूका लागि सिफारिस गरिएका MHPSS तालिमका विषयहरू हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Train rehabilitation workers and victim assistance case managers on relevant MHPSS topics (see MSP activity 3.13 and the recommended MHPSS training topics for case managers).
rows.note: The draft retains rehabilitation workers and victim assistance case managers as distinct training recipients and preserves the activity reference.

rows.en: ▶ Working with mine action centres and coordination groups to develop referral mechanisms and ensure access to MHPSS services and supports for EO survivors.
rows.ne: ▶ सेवा प्रेषण संयन्त्रहरू विकास गर्न र EO बाट बाँच्न सफल व्यक्तिहरूका लागि MHPSS सेवा तथा सहयोगमा पहुँच सुनिश्चित गर्न बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने केन्द्रहरू र समन्वय समूहहरूसँग मिलेर काम गर्ने।
rows.bt: ▶ Work together with mine action centres and coordination groups to develop service referral mechanisms and ensure access to MHPSS services and support for people who have survived EO.
rows.note: General safety guidance draft; review pending. Proposed glossary addition: EO survivors = EO [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]. EO remains unexpanded.

rows.en: ▶ Monitoring MHPSS-related outputs and outcomes (e.g. improvements in well-being following the inclusion of support groups at rehabilitation centres, the strengthening of survivor networks).
rows.ne: ▶ MHPSS सँग सम्बन्धित प्रतिफल र परिणामहरूको अनुगमन गर्ने (जस्तै, पुनर्स्थापना केन्द्रहरूमा सहयोग समूहहरू समावेश गरेपछि कल्याणमा आएको सुधार, बाँच्न सफल व्यक्तिहरूका सञ्जालको सुदृढीकरण)।
rows.bt: ▶ Monitor outputs and outcomes related to MHPSS (for example, improvement in well-being after including support groups in rehabilitation centres, strengthening of networks of people who have survived).
rows.note: The examples retain both improved well-being following the inclusion of support groups and the strengthening of survivor networks.

rows.en: See relevant resources on the MHPSS MSP web platform.
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP वेब प्लेटफर्ममा रहेका सान्दर्भिक स्रोतहरू हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: See the relevant resources on the MHPSS MSP web platform.

rows.en: Key consideration 7: Integrating MHPSS into nutrition programming
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 7: पोषणसम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकरण
rows.bt: Key consideration 7: Integrating MHPSS into nutrition programme planning and implementation
rows.note: Proposed glossary additions: key consideration = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]; programming = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.en: The cognitive, social and emotional development of children depends on both adequate nutrition and nurturing care. Emergencies can severely limit caregivers’ abilities to provide these, due to both the practical disruption to food supply and the impact of the emergency on their own mental health and psychosocial well-being. Nutrition, mental health and development are interlinked in a range of ways that can be disrupted in emergencies. For example, malnourished children may show reduced activity and seek less interaction with caregivers; where caregivers consequently reduce the amount of stimulation provided, this can lead to further developmental disadvantages. Caregiver well-being can also impact child nutrition; for example, mothers experiencing depression are less likely to continue breastfeeding their child and provide less stimulation.
rows.ne: बालबालिकाको संज्ञानात्मक, सामाजिक र भावनात्मक विकास पर्याप्त पोषण र बाल विकासलाई पोषण गर्ने स्याहार दुवैमा निर्भर हुन्छ। आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा खाद्य आपूर्तिमा आउने व्यावहारिक अवरोध र हेरचाहकर्ताको आफ्नै मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा पर्ने प्रभाव दुवैका कारण यी कुरा उपलब्ध गराउने उनीहरूको क्षमतामा गम्भीर सीमा पर्न सक्छ। पोषण, मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र विकास विभिन्न तरिकाले एकअर्कासँग जोडिएका हुन्छन्, र आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा यी अन्तरसम्बन्धहरू बिथोलिन सक्छन्। उदाहरणका लागि, कुपोषित बालबालिका कम सक्रिय हुन सक्छन् र हेरचाहकर्तासँग कम अन्तरक्रिया खोज्न सक्छन्; फलस्वरूप हेरचाहकर्ताले उनीहरूलाई दिने विकासात्मक उत्प्रेरणा घटाएमा यसले विकासमा थप प्रतिकूलता निम्त्याउन सक्छ। हेरचाहकर्ताको कल्याणले पनि बालबालिकाको पोषणमा प्रभाव पार्न सक्छ; उदाहरणका लागि, [depression] अनुभव गरिरहेका आमाहरूले आफ्नो बच्चालाई स्तनपान गराइरहने सम्भावना कम हुन्छ र उनीहरूले कम विकासात्मक उत्प्रेरणा दिन्छन्।
rows.bt: Children's cognitive, social and emotional development depends on both adequate nutrition and care that nurtures child development. In emergencies, both practical disruptions to food supplies and the effects on caregivers' own mental health and psychosocial well-being can severely limit their ability to provide these things. Nutrition, mental health and development are interconnected in various ways, and these interconnections can be disrupted in emergencies. For example, malnourished children may be less active and may seek less interaction with caregivers; if caregivers consequently reduce the developmental stimulation they give them, this can lead to further adverse effects on development. Caregivers' well-being can also affect children's nutrition; for example, mothers experiencing [depression] are less likely to continue breastfeeding their child and give less developmental stimulation.
rows.note: The diagnostic name is retained exactly in English; possibilities, conditional developmental effects and the comparison concerning breastfeeding are preserved.

rows.en: Nutrition actors can integrate MHPSS into programming by:
rows.ne: पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूले निम्न तरिकाले कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: Actors working in the nutrition sector can integrate MHPSS into programme planning and implementation in the following ways.
rows.note: Proposed glossary addition: programming = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.en: ▶ Providing nutrition services in ways that support mental health and psychosocial well-being, for example, by engaging target communities and ensuring that nutrition services are provided in a dignified manner and in a safe and culturally appropriate environment. MHPSS considerations should be taken into account in the design of therapeutic feeding centres and outpatient therapeutic programmes (see Sphere Management of Malnutrition standard 2.1).
rows.ne: ▶ मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणलाई सहयोग पुग्ने तरिकाले पोषण सेवाहरू प्रदान गर्ने, उदाहरणका लागि लक्षित समुदायहरूलाई सहभागी गराएर र पोषण सेवाहरू मर्यादापूर्ण ढङ्गले तथा सुरक्षित र सांस्कृतिक रूपमा उपयुक्त वातावरणमा प्रदान गरिने सुनिश्चित गरेर। उपचारात्मक आहार उपलब्ध गराउने केन्द्रहरू र बहिरङ्ग उपचार कार्यक्रमहरूको रूपरेखा तयार गर्दा MHPSS सम्बन्धी पक्षहरूलाई ध्यानमा राखिनुपर्छ ([Sphere Management of Malnutrition standard 2.1] हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Provide nutrition services in ways that support mental health and psychosocial well-being, for example by involving targeted communities and ensuring that nutrition services are provided in a dignified manner and in a safe and culturally appropriate environment. Aspects related to MHPSS should be taken into account when designing centres that provide therapeutic feeding and outpatient treatment programmes (see [Sphere Management of Malnutrition standard 2.1]).
rows.note: Therapeutic service settings are drafted as general service categories, and the cited standard is retained exactly in English.

rows.en: ▶ Orienting nutrition workers on basic psychosocial support and on nurturing care, including identification and referral of children and adults who may need MHPSS services and supports (see MSP activity 3.2; Sphere Management of Malnutrition standard 2.2).
rows.ne: ▶ MHPSS सेवा र सहयोग आवश्यक पर्न सक्ने बालबालिका तथा वयस्कको पहिचान गर्ने र सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्यसमेत समेटेर पोषण कार्यकर्तालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग र बाल विकासलाई पोषण गर्ने स्याहारबारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने (MSP गतिविधि 3.2; [Sphere Management of Malnutrition standard 2.2] हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Orient nutrition workers on basic psychosocial support and care that nurtures child development, including identifying children and adults who may need MHPSS services and support and referring them to relevant services (see MSP activity 3.2; [Sphere Management of Malnutrition standard 2.2]).
rows.note: The possibility of needing services is retained, and the cited standard remains exactly in English.

rows.en: ▶ Integrateing relevant key MHPSS messages into nutrition information materials (see MSP activity 3.3).
rows.ne: ▶ पोषणसम्बन्धी सूचना सामग्रीमा सान्दर्भिक प्रमुख MHPSS सन्देशहरू एकीकृत गर्ने (MSP गतिविधि 3.3 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: ▶ Integrate relevant key MHPSS messages into nutrition-related information materials (see MSP activity 3.3).
rows.note: The source word 'Integrateing' is irregular; the draft follows the apparent intended meaning of integrating messages without validating that wording.

rows.en: ▶ Monitoring MHPSS-related outputs and outcomes (e.g. improvements in well-being following the implementation of mother-baby and child group activities at outreach therapeutic programmes).
rows.ne: ▶ MHPSS सँग सम्बन्धित प्रतिफल र परिणामहरूको अनुगमन गर्ने (जस्तै, सेवाग्राहीसम्म पुगेर सञ्चालन गरिने उपचार कार्यक्रमहरूमा आमा–शिशु र बालबालिकाका समूहगत गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गरेपछि कल्याणमा आएको सुधार)।
rows.bt: ▶ Monitor outputs and outcomes related to MHPSS (for example, improvement in well-being after implementing mother–infant and children's group activities in treatment programmes conducted by reaching out to service users).
rows.note: The example retains the timing of well-being improvements after group activities and the outreach character of the therapeutic programmes.

rows.en: For further information on the linkages between MHPSS and Nutrition, see key consideration 24.

rows.bt: Key consideration 8: Integrating MHPSS into camp coordination and camp management programme planning and implementation
